pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the letter ö made? (1 mark)
   A. Say oh with wide lips
   B. Say ow
   C. Say ay with round lips
   D. Say ee with wide lips

2. Which little word goes with the noun "Samstag"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

3. What does "Welcher Tag ist heute?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Which day is it today?
   B. Where is the school?
   C. How old are you?
   D. What is the weather today?

4. What does "der Stuhl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fridge
   B. chair
   C. plate
   D. bathroom

5. What does "sprechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to eat
   B. to speak
   C. to help
   D. to play

6. What does "deckt den Tisch" mean? (1 mark)
   A. cooks the food
   B. lays the table
   C. cleans the floor
   D. opens the door

7. In "Geburtstag", how do you say the letter "u"? (1 mark)
   A. like yoo
   B. like ow
   C. like oo
   D. like uh

8. Which little word goes with the noun "Toilette"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

9. What does "kühl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. windy
   C. warm
   D. cool

10. What does "der Kühlschrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bed
   B. living room
   C. window
   D. fridge

11. Which of these is NOT a noun? (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Fußball
   C. spiele
   D. Montag

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Teller"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

13. How many umlaut letters does German have? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 3
   C. 4
   D. 5

14. How is the letter U named in German? (1 mark)
   A. oo
   B. bay
   C. ess
   D. yot

15. Which noun goes with "meine"? (1 mark)
   A. Bruder
   B. Mutter
   C. Onkel
   D. Vater

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

17. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

18. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

19. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

20. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Say ay with round lips
   ö is made with the lips rounded.

2. A — der
   It is der Samstag, so the little word is der.

3. A — Which day is it today?
   Welcher Tag means which day and heute means today.

4. B — chair
   der Stuhl means chair.

5. B — to speak
   sprechen means to speak.

6. B — lays the table
   den Tisch decken means to lay the table.

7. C — like oo
   The u in Geburtstag is said oo.

8. C — die
   It is die Toilette, so the little word is die.

9. D — cool
   kühl means cool.

10. D — fridge
   der Kühlschrank means fridge.

11. C — spiele
   spiele is a verb. Nouns begin with capital letters.

12. D — der
   It is der Teller, so the little word is der.

13. B — 3
   The umlauts are ä, ö and ü.

14. A — oo
   In German the letter U is called oo.

15. B — Mutter
   Mutter is a die word, so we say meine Mutter.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.
